Based on the sources provided, the Education Minister being demanded to resign by the Cockroach Janta Party in India in 2026 is **Dharmendra Pradhan** [2].

The sources indicate that the Cockroach Janta Party staged protests at Jantar Mantar demanding his resignation over the 2026 NEET controversy [2], and he subsequently resigned from the position [3][5], being replaced by Pralhad Joshi [3].

hits.text: The Cockroach Janta Party organises the Sansad Chalo March demanding the resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan over the 2026 NEET controversy.

6 June – 2026 Delhi Jantar Mantar protests: The Cockroach Janta Party led by Abhijeet Dipke stages protests at Jantar Mantar demanding the resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan over the 2026 NEET controversy.
Dharmendra Pradhan resigns as Education Minister amid outrage over the 2026 NEET controversy. He is replaced by Pralhad Joshi.

June 6 – A group of young Indian students and leftists formed an unofficial Cockroach Janta Party, precipitating a series of nationwide protests in Jantar Mantar, New Delhi over a leak of NEET exam previously occurred one month earlier on May 3.
July 25 – Indian Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigns from the position in light of the protests over a NEET exam leak. Most of the protests ceased following his resignation.
